title_zh: 天津援藏前方指挥部召开临时党委会 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神
title_en: Tianjin Aid-Tibet Front Command Holds Temporary Party Committee Meeting on Xi Jinping's Key Remarks
summary_zh: 日前，天津市对口支援西藏工作前方指挥部临时党委召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，临时党委书记、总指挥李树国主持会议。
summary_en: Tianjin's front command for paired assistance to Tibet held a temporary Party committee meeting to convey Xi Jinping's key speech; Party secretary and general commander Li Shuguo chaired.
